description:
[Deterministic public procurement audit. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits subcontracting cascading limits under Art. 119 D.Lgs 36/2023, SIOS specialized works prohibitions, non-rebate workplace safety costs, and mandatory CCNL equivalent worker protections.
Usage: Use this tool to verify whether a subcontracting request is legally permissible under Italian public tender rules.
Returns: JSON object with { isPermissible: boolean, maxCascadeAllowed: number, safetyCostsProtected: boolean, ccnlEquivalenceRequired: boolean, violations: string[] }.

mainContractCcnl.description: Labor collective agreement prescribed by main tender

mainContractValueEur.description: Total main contract value in EUR

mandatorySafetyCostsEur.description: Mandatory non-rebate workplace safety costs in EUR

subcontractorCcnl.description: Labor collective agreement applied by subcontractor

name: subappalto_cascade_limiter
